parts:
Dear Zhian,

I'm a poppr user and it's really powerful and flexible to my polyploidy data set. I noticed that your development group has contributed lots of efforts to the data visualization and its effect is pretty good based on my use experience. However, I guess it will become more handy and powerful if you would like to add some parameters, for example, font sizes, styles or colors in your default setting of parameters for data visualization. So could you post some codes for these effects of visualization?


Thanks,
Jianan

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: Request to adding some parameters for more handy and beautiful data visualization
parts:
Hi Jianan,

I apologize for not replying to this sooner. I will post a tutorial on this soon. As far as giving specific options in the functions for the customization of fonts and other aspects, I will consider it. There are, however many permutations of possibilities regarding visualization customization where it becomes challenging on the programming side when factors like fonts (not standardized across systems) come into play. Since many of the plots in poppr are ggplot2 plots, they can be manipulated in R after the fact. In section 4.2 of the poppr manual, there are basic instructions on how to manipulate these graphics. Again, I will post a tutorial soon on this subject.

Cheers,
Zhian
